title: Diamond Diadem
description: Whenever you play [blue]2[/blue] or fewer cards in a turn, take half damage from enemies.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the number of cards played each turn. When you play 2 or fewer cards in a turn, applies DiamondDiademPower at the end of that turn. A counter displays the number of cards played this turn and resets at the start of each turn.
